$comment: Example active-module declaration for the rawframe lane. The pre-task-026 version of this file referenced Stage A vestige labels (more, play, want, need, come, sorry, car, open) that no longer exist in web/src/lib/vocabulary.ts; those references were removed under task-005. Until the rawframe model is trained, every module here is a CANDIDATE only — the source-of-truth for what is actually 'active' is docs/model/active-vocabulary-claim.json, whose activeLabels[] must stay empty while modelVersion == 'rawframe-not-trained'. After mission 3 produces a trained model, scripts/promote_trained_model_card.mjs writes the promoted module's labels into active-vocabulary-claim.json (this file remains an example seed for other modules that might be promoted later).

modules.purpose: first 10-sign smoke module, all labels present in web/src/lib/vocabulary.ts and seeded with structured hint metadata in web/src/lib/sign-hint-metadata.json
modules.claim: candidate only — not active until docs/model/active-vocabulary-claim.json lists these labels under activeLabels[] (which happens only after Brev training + signer-disjoint metrics + threshold calibration)

modules.purpose: candidate 20-sign expansion, all labels present in current vocabulary
modules.claim: candidate only — gated on smoke_10 passing first per the downscope ladder in ARCHITECTURE.md#arch-downscope-ladder
